name: Ragi cookies
ingredients_raw: Ragi flour (33%), refined wheat flour (28%), edible vegetable oil (palm), maltitol (965), inulin, milk solids, maltodextrin, natural fruit fiber (apple-1.6%), raising agents [503(ii), 500(ii), 450(i)], edible common salt, emulsifiers (322, 412, 472e, 471), cinnamon (0.5%), dough conditioner (223) and sweetener (955). Contains added flavours [nature identical and artificial flavouring substances (butter, milk masala & vanilla)].
